# Q-051 E13: a_usd_deposit_booked_as_the_invoice_it_collected.txt with the
# fee's cost basis cleared, `cost_basis_split_guid: ""`. A block leaving the
# line out keeps the pick the split has; this one takes it off. Read as a new
# transaction, the fee then spends dollars the transaction collects without
# saying which cost basis they came out of, so the edit is refused, and the
# transaction is left as it was.
#
# `txn_type: P` as the export of a payment writes it. The refused edit sets
# it before its commit, and the transaction is put back with the type it had:
# GnuCash 3.4 to 4.8 store the type and keep it, and a later GnuCash works it
# out from the splits.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_statement_line_on_a_holding_account_is_edited_into_what_it_settles.py.
